# SAIS Events

> SAIS Events (SAIS EXPO COORDINATORS) takes business owners, importers and manufacturers from Africa and the Middle East to international trade fairs as vetted delegates and hosted buyers, and brings qualified buyers to expo organisers' shows. Offices in Nairobi, Kenya and Dubai, UAE.

## Key pages
- [Home and upcoming expos](https://saisevents.com/): what SAIS Events does and the full expo list
- [Questions and answers](https://saisevents.com/faq.html): hosted buyer programmes, vetting, documents, costs, visas
- [For expo organisers](https://saisevents.com/partner.html): how SAIS recruits and vets buyers for organisers
- [SAIS MatchMarket](https://saisevents.com/matchmarket.html): free vetted B2B matchmaking platform
- [AFROPLAST 2027 registration](https://saisevents.com/afroplast-2027.html): official East Africa hosted buyer registration, Cairo, 9 to 12 January 2027
- [ALUMINIUM CHINA 2027 registration](https://saisevents.com/aluminium-china-2027.html): Africa hosted buyer registration, Shanghai, 7 to 9 July 2027
- [Food Africa Cairo 2026](https://saisevents.com/food-africa-2026.html): hosted buyer programme, 7 to 10 December 2026
- [VIP Members Programme](https://saisevents.com/vip-members.html): one-time USD 300 membership
- [Delegates whitelist](https://saisevents.com/membership.html)
